conviction_note: Q3 is a new-numbers release (Orange Polska pre-releases only its Q4 figures, in February) with a second guidance raise plausible: FY consensus EBITDAaL of +5.9% sits at or just under the company's own '>6%' guide, the CEO said the guide was set there because H2 could push it higher, and the stock moved +11.9% the last time the guide went up. Against that, the stock rose 21-23% into the print on broker upgrades, the Q1 beat was sold (-1.4%), Q3 number-porting fell to +8.6k from about 20k, and the Q3 EBITDAaL bar is disputed (Parkiet quotes '1 bn, +1.7%' while PKO BP calls for +12%). So abs_move is 4.8 (roughly 45% odds of a guide change at about 8-9%, otherwise about 2%), p_up is 53, and the findings sum to +0.5. The two numbers agree in sign and are about the same size.

already_public.what: FY2026 guide raised with H1: revenue low-to-mid single-digit growth, EBITDAaL >6% (was 3-5%), organic cash flow >= PLN 1.2bn (was 1.1bn), eCAPEX PLN 1.8bn
CFO: IT&IS revenue growth less spectacular in H2 than Q2's +50%; CEO: guide set at '>6%' because strong H2 execution could push it higher

Nexera acquisition completed 30 Sep 2026 (EV ~PLN 1.5bn, ~PLN 0.5bn consideration split 50/50 with APG, up to PLN 130m shareholder funding over 12 months), contributed to the equity-accounted Swiatlowod Inwestycje JV
Company-collected consensus (median of 8 brokers): Q3 revenue PLN 3.5bn (+5.3%), EBITDAaL ~PLN 1bn, EBIT 487m (+31.3%), net profit 316m (+38.6%, range 304-327m)
UKE Q3 2026 number-porting: Orange net +8,637, T-Mobile +26,541, Play -10,782, Plus -50,935

new_in_release.expect: FY2026 EBITDAaL guide '>6%' either confirmed or lifted (Trigon says ~8% is achievable). I lean slightly toward a lift, on 9M tracking (H1 +6.2%) and the CEO's July framing. This is the line that moves the stock.
EBITDAaL slightly above the PAP-style bar, going by four straight beats of 0.6-3.8%. The bar itself is disputed: Q3 EBITDAaL somewhere between ~914m and ~1,007m.
Unknown. 9M organic cash flow against the >= PLN 1.2bn guide. The Nexera consideration (~PLN 250m OPL share) is M&A and should sit outside organic cash flow.
Q3 mobile KPIs: slower postpaid net adds are likely, given that net porting fell to +8.6k from ~20k in Q2. Possibly a first Nexera/FiberCo footprint update.
Not expected to change: PLN 0.61 is the baseline through 2028.

bar: Disputed. The company-collected median of 8 brokers (Parkiet 2026-10-13, https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45319801-analitycy-kwartalny-zysk-netto-orange-polska-urosl-o-prawie-40-proc; StockWatch 2026-10-19, https://www.stockwatch.pl/wiadomosci/sezon-wynikow-iii-kwartal-2026-gpw-xtb-kruk-orange-quercus-tfi,akcje,383207) gives revenue PLN 3.5bn (range 3.48-3.56), net profit 316m (304-327) and EBIT 487m. EBITDAaL is quoted as '~1 bn' with '+1.7% y/y' on a Q3'25 base of 899m, and those two cannot both be true. PKO BP expects +12% (https://www.parkiet.com/rekomendacje/art45215371-orange-polska-w-gronie-faworytow-sezonu-wynikow-iii-kwartalu). FY2026 EBITDAaL consensus is PLN 3.677bn (+5.9%) against the company's own '>6%' guide. Because the EBITDAaL bar is unsettled, findings on the quarter are capped small.
session_check: amc. Current report 2/2026 schedules the Q3 2026 extended consolidated report for 26.10.2026 (https://www.orange-ir.pl/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/RB-2-2026-daty-raportowania.pdf). The company's last two releases came out after the 17:00 GPW close: Q2 guidance at 2026-07-27 21:26 (https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/Orange-Polska-podwyzszylo-prognoze-przychodow-do-sredniego-jednocyfrowego-wzrostu-oraz-ponad-6-proc-EBITDAaL-w-26-9174028.html; H1 commentary filename stamped 20260727_205415) and Q1 at 2026-04-22 18:08 (https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/Orange-Polska-podtrzymalo-niski-jednocyfrowy-wzrost-przychodow-3-5-proc-wzrost-EBITDAaL-w-26-9121243.html). Both reactions landed the next day (+11.93% on 07-28, -1.38% on 04-23). The window is therefore the 26 Oct close to the 27 Oct close.
positioning_check: Register not covered for this market. The KNF short-position register returns 403 from this container and gpw.pl / espi.pap.pl refuse, so nothing is known about short interest in OPL. That is unknown, not zero. priced_lean_pct (-1.163) is the 20-day run-up alone, which is also the free control, so a finding that merely agrees with the run-up adds nothing measurable.

findings.finding: FY2026 EBITDAaL consensus (PLN 3.677bn, +5.9%) sits at or just below the company's own '>6%' guide. H1 ran +6.2%, the CEO said the guide was set at '>6%' because strong H2 execution could push it higher, and Trigon calls ~8% achievable. A second 2026 raise with Q3 is therefore plausible and not in consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide raise with Q2 (27 Jul 2026) moved the stock +11.93% the next session. The FY2026 first guide with the February 2026 preliminary results was followed by +5.95% on 18 Feb. The Q1 'upper end of guide' talk without a formal raise got -1.38%.
findings.original_quote: Mediana prognoz biur maklerskich dla EBITDAaL w 2026 r. to 3,677 mld zł (+5,9% r/r) ... konsensus jest 'nieco bardziej konserwatywna' niż założenia zarządu (paraphrase from the article; the brokers' median sits below the >6% guide). Bankier/PAP 2026-07-28: Climoc said EBITDAaL 'przekroczy 6 proc.'
findings.why_not_priced: If the market were holding a raise, FY consensus would sit above 6% rather than at 5.9%. The +23% 20-day run-up came on a PKO BP hold-to-buy upgrade and 'strong Q3' calls, not on a higher FY number. Part of this is still in the run-up, which is why the finding is held at +1.2 and not sized at the ~9% a raise usually carries.
findings.independence: Same direction from the company itself: https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/Orange-Polska-moze-zakonczyc-26-z-wyzszym-niz-6-proc-wzrostem-EBITDAal-9174281.html (CEO, 2026-07-28).

findings.finding: Orange Polska has beaten the PAP EBITDAaL consensus on four straight quarters (Q2'25 891 vs 866, Q3'25 899 vs 878, Q1'26 913 vs 880, Q2'26 929 vs 923), which points to a small Q3 EBITDAaL beat against whatever bar the market holds.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beats without a guide change have been sold or ignored: Q1'26 beat by 3.8% and the stock went -1.38%. Q3'25 beat by 2.4% with moves under 2% around the print.
findings.original_quote: Orange Polska miało w II kw. 929 mln zł EBITDA z kosztami leasingu wobec 923,1 mln zł konsensusu
findings.why_not_priced: Habitual small beats are mostly expected, and the bar is disputed (914m vs ~1,007m), so this is capped small. If the market expected more, the street median would sit above the 899m base by more than +1.7%, and it may already (PKO +12%).

findings.finding: The independent UKE number-porting series shows Orange's Q3 2026 net porting gain fell to +8,637, down from 'prawie 20 tys.' in Q2. T-Mobile took the lead at +26,541, so Orange lost the porting leadership its Q2 release highlighted.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to a KPI miss on its own. The Q2 commercial momentum was part of the +11.93% day.
findings.original_quote: Orange Polska: nr oddane 99 216, nr pozyskane 107 853, bilans 8 637 (table); Q2 press release: 'zyskaliśmy w ramach przenoszenia numerów prawie 20 tys. użytkowników netto'
findings.why_not_priced: The series has been public since 7 Oct and the stock rose afterwards, so it is largely priced. It still matters if the release confirms slower postpaid adds (85k in Q2) and management has to explain the lost leadership. Small.

findings.finding: The stock rose from ~13.0 to ~16.0 PLN (+21-23%) between 29 Sep and 22 Oct on a PKO BP hold-to-buy upgrade (target 17), Q3 'season favourite' calls and a Quercus TFI 'market star' comment. The bar for the release is elevated, and the last plain beat (Q1) was sold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the +11.93% on 28 Jul the stock gave back -2.9% the next day and ~20% by late September. The Q1 beat drew -1.38%.
findings.original_quote: Cendecki (Quercus TFI): Orange Polska jest 'gwiazdą rynku', ale nie wiadomo, czy będzie gwiazdą sezonu wyników; rynek oczekuje 'wysokich, jednocyfrowych dynamik wyników'
findings.why_not_priced: This is a statement about what is priced, not new information. It agrees with the run-up lean (-1.16), which is also the free control, so it is sized small and adds little measurable edge.

findings.finding: Nexera closed on 30 Sep, the last day of Q3: OPL's share is ~PLN 250m of the ~PLN 0.5bn consideration plus up to ~PLN 65m of a PLN 130m funding commitment. The asset sits in the equity-accounted FiberCo, which lifts its footprint ambition to ~4m households by 2030. Analysts expect no material one-offs in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The original deal (19 Dec 2025) and the EC approval (24 Aug 2026) produced no visible move.
findings.why_not_priced: Fully public and modest against a ~PLN 21bn market cap. The money buys wholesale FTTH footprint, which feeds OPL's growing wholesale line, so there is no distress read. Sized at 0 unless the release shows a Q3 cash-flow or net-debt surprise.

findings.finding: The Vice-President for the Business Market (B2B, the driver of Q2's +50% IT&IS revenue) resigned effective 16 Oct and was replaced internally. Together with the CFO's July warning of 'less spectacular' H2 IT&IS growth, this is a mild drag on the B2B line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to the 2 Oct filing; the stock rose that week.
findings.why_not_priced: Public and inside the company's own warning. The revenue consensus (+5.3% y/y vs +12.3% in Q2) already embeds the IT&IS slowdown, so this is near 0.

baseline_tension: Mixed. The guidance finding cuts against the negative run-up lean (-1.16); the positioning and porting findings agree with it. Net, the set is close to flat and slightly positive, so it barely departs from the free control.
language_note: The company-collected 8-broker consensus (revenue 3.5bn, EBIT 487m, NI 316m, ranges) appeared only in Polish press (Parkiet, StockWatch); the English wires carried only a revenue figure
The PKO BP upgrade that drove the 30 Sep +9.6% day, and the brokers' FY EBITDAaL median of 3.677bn sitting below the company's >6% guide, appeared only in Parkiet

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance moves a median 9.0%, guidance findings 11 of 17 on sign): guidance finding raised from +0.8 to +1.2, abs_move_pct from 4.2 to 4.8, p_up from 50 to 53

'You were right about the number and too small about the move': added the four-quarter EBITDAaL beat record as its own reported_quarter finding (+0.3, capped because the bar is disputed) and set print_vs_bar_pct to +1.5. This fact was gathered in the hunt but not sized in the draft
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': organic cash flow vs the >=1.2bn guide added as an explicit new_in_release line; nothing sourced to size it
'Positioning is the thing to beat': the run-up finding kept small (-0.6), because it restates the lean/free control
